description: Zenith machine.service.restart: restart one systemd unit and report its state. Mutating. Output format zenith.service.restart/v1.

unit.description: systemd unit name ending in .service, .socket or .timer.

executionTimeout.description: Seconds before the command is considered failed (1-999).

runCommand: [ -n "$unit" ] || die 64 'parameter unit is empty (SSM Agent >= 3.3.2746.0 is required for ENV_VAR parameters)'
case "$unit" in -*|*[!A-Za-z0-9@._:-]*) die 64 'invalid unit name' ;; esac
case "$unit" in *.service|*.socket|*.timer) ;; *) die 64 'invalid unit name' ;; esac

case "$unit" in ssh.service|sshd.service|ssh.socket|sshd.socket|ssh@*|sshd@*|systemd-*|dbus.service|dbus.socket|dbus-broker.service|dbus-broker.socket|amazon-ssm-agent.service|snap.amazon-ssm-agent.*|zenithd.service|zenith-runner.service) die 65 'unit is protected and cannot be restarted through Zenith' ;; esac
for a in $allow; do [ "$a" = "$unit" ] && ok=1; done
[ "$ok" = 1 ] || die 65 'unit is not on the restart allowlist for this environment'
command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 69 'systemctl is not available on this machine'
[ -d /run/systemd/system ] || die 69 'systemd is not running on this machine'
out=$(systemctl restart -- "$unit" 2>&1) || die 1 "systemctl restart failed: $(printf '%s' "$out" | head -c 300)"
